title: Make layouts responsive on mobile
description: Home grid-cols-3 crushes cards to ~100px at 390px width; dashboard grid-cols-[355px_1fr] same issue. Stack on small screens.

title: Dashboard log stream: unbounded, ANSI codes, public exposure
description: 1) log_msgs in dashboard_page.ex grows forever -> cap (~100). 2) ANSI escape codes render as text in SQL debug lines -> strip them. 3) LogBroadcaster broadcasts every log line to all visitors; prod is :info so SQL is excluded but request paths etc. go out. Decide on a filter (level/module allowlist) before public feature.
close_reason: Merged 956cca2, a080235: capped at 100, ANSI stripped, minimal payload, OTP handler level+filters, crash-proof handler, Hologram/Bandit/crash logs filtered, README documents exposure

title: Remove stray dbg/1 calls
description: lib/holodeck/polls.ex:9 and lib/holodeck_web/pages/poll/vote_page.ex:31. They also leak into the public log stream.
close_reason: Merged fix/poll-bugs (ebd45e3): removed dbg calls, added vote error toast

title: Missing room/poll returns 500
description: /chat/doesnotexist and /poll/<unknown-uuid> (also /vote) crash because room/poll is nil in init: room_page.ex:13-19, result_page.ex:16-24, vote_page.ex:14. Render a not-found state or redirect to lobby/poll list.
notes: Polls half merged to main (0596ffa, 66ee0b0). Chat half pending on fix/chat-bugs.

title: Duplicate room name raises instead of toasting
description: DB has unique_index(:rooms, [:name]) but Room.create_changeset (lib/holodeck/chat/room.ex) lacks unique_constraint(:name), so Repo.insert raises Ecto.ConstraintError and the lobby's error toast never appears.
acceptance_criteria: Creating an existing room name shows an error toast.

title: Chat room: compose box below the fold, whole page scrolls
description: room_page.holo uses min-h-screen so the page grows; the form sat at y=867 in an 800px viewport with ~13 messages. Use h-screen, make only the message list scroll, start scrolled to newest message.
acceptance_criteria: Message input always visible; message list scrolls independently and opens at the latest message.

title: Sending a chat message with no username fails silently
description: Users can join a room with no session username; Chat.create_message fails validation and room_page.ex:50 is a TODO. Show a toast (Toast component, target "toast") and/or require a username before entering a room.

title: Fix visitor-facing bugs before Hologram site feature
description: Bugs a visitor arriving from hologram.page would hit within a minute. Found during a walkthrough audit on 2026-11-10.
close_reason: All visitor-facing bugs fixed and merged

title: Dashboard polish: CPU density, live indicator, labels, log alignment
description: Many cores (28+) push memory/logs far down -> compact grid or average. 'connected' pill is hardcoded. 'BEAM / OTP' label shows Elixir version. Log rows are separate grids so columns misalign. Show initial_call for unnamed processes.
notes: From dashboard review: log times are shown in UTC with no label; label them or convert client-side.

title: Style form inputs and use real labels (poll + chat lobby)
description: Poll form inputs have no border/bg/placeholder so the page looks like labels + a button. Labels are <span>; use <label for>. Same for chat lobby username/room inputs.

title: Chat polish: timestamps, username colours, width, save feedback
description: Raw UTC NaiveDateTime -> relative/local time. username_colour hashes only first byte (all 'A' names same colour) -> hash whole name. Room page is full-width vs 1180px elsewhere. Saving username gives no feedback (toast).
notes: From chat-bugs review: the Toast (toast.ex, fixed bottom-5 right-5) covers the now-pinned chat composer's Send button for 4s on errors, and nearly the full width on mobile. Move toasts to the top, or offset them above the composer.

title: Polls: poll list, share link, results-page fixes
description: No list of polls and no share/copy vote link, so new visitors see nothing. Pluralisation ('1 VOTES'). Results still says 'Haven't voted yet?' after voting (remember in session). Chart.js uses default greys and duplicates the bar list: theme or pick one.
notes: From poll-bugs review: results page 'No-JS fallback' bars show 0 until :init_chart runs, because frequencies starts as %{} in init. Compute frequencies server-side in init. Also: the not-found state (from hd-adl.1) is plain and duplicated in result/vote pages, and the breadcrumb still says Results/Vote. Restyle it with the AppShell work.

title: Extract shared AppShell/Nav component; rename Chat.Layout
description: HolodeckWeb.Chat.Layout is used by every page -> rename to HolodeckWeb.Layout. Nav + hd-grain + hd-glow markup is duplicated across 7 templates; extract a component with a breadcrumb prop and <slot />. Doubles as a Hologram components showcase.

title: Dashboard 'pid' sort actually sorts by memory
description: lib/holodeck/dashboard.ex:11 maps :pid -> :total_heap_size. Sort by pid instead.

title: Dashboard memory column ~8x too low
description: Uses Process.info total_heap_size, which is in words, rendered through format_bytes. Use :memory (bytes) for both display and the memory sort.

title: UI/UX polish pass
description: Visual and usability polish so the app looks finished when featured.

title: Document 'mix holo' (not phx.server) in AGENTS.md
description: In dev/test, Hologram's supervision tree (incl. Hologram.PubSub) and compiler only start when HOLOGRAM_START=1 (deps/hologram/lib/hologram/application.ex:63). mix holo sets it. The Phoenix habit of mix phx.server, which AGENTS.md encourages, runs without PubSub, so broadcasts silently fail. Add a one-line note to AGENTS.md (and the README if useful).

title: Demo: client-side Game of Life
description: Grid with click-to-toggle, play/pause/step/reset. Simulation is pure Elixir in actions driven by a delayed self-scheduling action (like the dashboard tick); no commands. Show a '0 server requests' counter. Highlights Elixir running in the browser.

title: Demo: shared Kanban board
description: Columns/cards as stateful components with their own cid; optimistic moves persisted via command and broadcast to other clients; drag-and-drop via Hologram.JS (native DnD or SortableJS). Highlights nested stateful components and targeted actions.

title: Home: pin 'Open ->' links to card bottom
description: Card component: make card flex-col with link at mt-auto so links align across cards.

title: Per-page <title>s
description: Every page is titled 'Holodeck'. Helps shared links and tabs.

title: Breadcrumbs link to parent sections
description: Poll results/vote breadcrumbs don't link back to Polls; make crumbs consistent across pages.

title: Add context tests for Chat and Polls
description: Only generated Phoenix tests exist. Cover create_room (incl. duplicate), create_message, create_poll, vote.

title: Remove dead PageController / home.html.heex / get "/" route
description: Hologram.Router is plugged before HolodeckWeb.Router in endpoint.ex, so the Phoenix home route is unreachable. Update page_controller_test accordingly.

title: New demo apps
description: Current apps all showcase real-time server push. Add demos for what's unique to Hologram: Elixir running client-side, and stateful nested components.

title: Code cleanup: make the source a good Hologram reference
description: People will read this source to learn Hologram; tidy duplication and dead code.

title: Investigate NoRouteError for GET /hologram/sse during navigation
description: Seen in the dashboard log stream right after page navigation. May be a Hologram quirk; check before reporting upstream.

title: Remove unused hd-* CSS classes and stale chart comment
description: app.css: hd-bar-fill, hd-bar-fill-hot, hd-mem-fill, hd-mini-fill, hd-pause-btn unused. result_page.holo:27-34 comment describes data-* attributes that don't exist.

title: Collapse dashboard sort_* actions into one parameterised action
description: Replace sort_memory/sort_reductions/sort_pid with $click={:sort, by: :memory} etc. Shows action params.

title: Delete [audit] test poll from dev DB
description: Poll '[audit] Best BEAM language?' (id 42fc7a73-7e36-440e-b2a7-05103aa21e57, 1 vote) was created during the audit.
close_reason: Deleted audit poll and its 1 vote from holodeck_dev
